run_prepare_data_2d_custom: run the prepare_data_2d_custom script to convert 2D detection npz files into a compressed dataset with COCO keypoints
decode_2d_detections: decode a single npz detection file, extract bounding boxes and keypoints, and interpolate missing frames
build_custom_2d_dataset: build a custom 2D pose dataset from Detectron detection outputs by specifying input directory and output suffix
process_keypoints_interpolate: process 2D keypoints and bounding boxes from npz files, selecting best detections and interpolating missing frames
save_compressed_dataset: save processed 2D positions and metadata into a compressed npz file with a custom output prefix
